_comment: Fixture manifest for the P4DB-1 Tushare proxy transport tests. Each entry maps a raw response body file (verbatim proxy JSON, no wrapper) to the api_name + params that produced it and the HTTP status code observed.

_provenance.reason: TUSHARE_PROXY_TOKEN was not available in the implementation environment. The proxy host pcd.mobcvb.cn is reachable and healthy, but every data route (POST /tushare/pro/{api_name}) requires an X-API-Key header and returned HTTP 401 {"ok":false,"error":"unauthorized"} for every unauthenticated probe. No live specimen could therefore be recorded.
_provenance.fixture_construction: Every body below is modeled byte-for-byte on the wire contract frozen in worker_tasks/phase4d_b/phase4d-b-plan.md (policy 11 / evidence item 8) and task-p4db-1-client.md (Required transport policies 1-3). They are test vectors for the documented proxy contract, NOT live captures. To capture real specimens, run: TUSHARE_PROXY_TOKEN=... .venv/bin/python -m smart_beta.vendors.tushare.proxy_client --out tests/fixtures/tushare/client "<api_name> <key>=<value> ...". This manifest's _provenance.live_recorded must then be set true.
